title.narrative: Promoting climate resilience and productivity for sustainable food and nutrition security among smallholder farmers

description.narrative: CGA, proposes to align with Christian Aid’s Thematic area 1, enabling communities to live with dignity by empowering them to anticipate, plan for, and respond successfully to climate-related disasters, risks and opportunities, and enable them to build thriving resilient livelihoods by implementing “To promoting climate resilience and productivity for sustainable food and nutrition security among smallholder farmers in Makueni County, Kenya”. The project targets to reach and impact 1,500 smallholder farmers in Makueni county. The interventions will ensure that the 1500 smallholder farmers successfully transition to climate resilient practices (CA and water harvesting and conservation techniques), enterprise diversification for increased food and nutrition security. It will adopt a gender transformative approach, removing structural and institutional barriers faced by women and youthful small-scale farmers in Makueni county. Special consideration will be given to women and youths during profiling and onboarding of FSCs.
